question: Maldives are located to the south of which island of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Maldives** are located to the south of the Indian island of **Lakshadweep**.
 
• The Maldives is an island nation in the Indian Ocean, situated southwest of Sri Lanka and India.
